plan: A ruined king who possesses the bodies of dead enemies to use their spells.
aSurveiller: His R (Heartbreaker). He swoops onto a champion and executes them: when low on health, stay away from him.
contrer: When low on health, back off: his R hurts more on wounded targets.
When he takes the body of a fallen ally, expect that ally's spells.
Keep crowd control: he relies on chaining his moves.
faiblesses: Weak if he doesn't kill anyone.

sorts.Q: Blade that deals percent health damage.
sorts.R: Swoops onto a champion and executes them.

momentFort: Weak in the early game. He becomes strong in the mid game, with 1 or 2 items.
